description: Without category_id creates a product category (name required); with category_id updates only the given fields. Can also add or remove products.

is_active.description: Visible in the storefront (new categories default to inactive in Medusa)

metadata.description: Merged into existing metadata; an empty string deletes a key

parent_category_id.description: null moves it to the top level

name: save_category
title: Create or update category
